{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check if missingness in flipper_length_mm is systematic by species
missing_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum())
print(missing_by_species)"}
